name: environment-profiling
when_to_use: When Hund needs to inspect, understand, or report its host hardware environment. Hund executes within this machine — the profile represents Hund's habitat.
steps: Run 'hund doctor' to inspect the live environment profile (OS, CPU, GPU, RAM, hostname, shell, installed developer tools).
Present the profile as Hund's habitat with grounded telemetry rather than a generic boilerplate report.
Identify hardware constraints (low CPU count, limited RAM, missing developer tools) and adapt execution behavior accordingly.
During installation or setup inquiries, verify that required toolchains exist (git, python, uv, node).
verification: hund doctor executes and returns live system telemetry
